Definition: from G4253 and G2090; to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively):--ordain before, prepare afore.
BiblicalUsage: Proetoimazo means to prepare beforehand, to fit up in advance. Paul says God prepared good works beforehand that we should walk in them, and prepared vessels of mercy beforehand unto glory.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that my good works were prepared before I was, and walking in them is simply stepping into what God made ready.
